properties.label: 大同城墙
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测
properties.enStatus: Original OSM mapped remains/reconstructed components; not archaeological survey
properties.note: 完整保留OSM relation 16200125原始外环及12个孔洞，包括城内主孔与各门防御庭院，不把墙体填成一整块实体。现状城墙含历史夯土遗存与2008年以来按明代规制修复、复建的包砖及构件，2016年四面合拢；原OSM亦注明historic=no，不能宣称所有表面均为明代原物。主城以1372年明代扩筑背景作为分期参照；不把整圈直接归为北魏或辽金实测城墙。
properties.enNote: The complete outer ring and all twelve original holes of OSM relation 16200125 are retained. Present walls combine historic rammed-earth remains with modern restoration/reconstruction, completed as a circuit in 2016. OSM itself marks historic=no; this is not entirely original Ming fabric. The Ming-phase reference begins with the 1372 expansion and is not a surveyed Northern Wei or Liao-Jin circuit.

properties.label: 大同府城
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测
properties.enStatus: Original OSM mapped remains/reconstructed components; not archaeological survey
properties.note: 直接采用原始城墙多边形的城内主孔边缘作为府城内部闭合参考面，随明清城墙筛选显示。轮廓贴合现状城墙，填充只表示城内范围；现代复建后的墙形不等于各期原始测绘边界。替代原BIAM sourceId 212主城粗轮廓的显示，原始数据存档不改；三个关城历史参考仍保留。
properties.enNote: The original city-wall central inner ring provides a closed reference for the city interior. It replaces display of the coarse BIAM main-city polygon 212 without altering the source dataset. Modern reconstructed wall geometry is not a surveyed boundary for every historical phase; three legacy outwork references remain.

properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测
properties.enStatus: Original OSM mapped remains/reconstructed components; not archaeological survey
properties.note: 保留城墙原始多边形内该处庭院孔洞的独立闭合轮廓；此面表示现状瓮城、月城或关城内部空间，不是墙体实体填充。名称按四门方位及地方官方城防构成说明对应，包含现代恢复构件，不当作已发掘的完整古城门原貌。
properties.enNote: This original wall-hole ring represents a present defensive courtyard, not solid wall fabric. Names follow the gate orientation and officially described defense arrangement. Restored components are included; it is not an excavated original gate complex.

properties.note: 原始OSM已命名城门通道线，位于现状城墙门道内，保留开放线；不把附近车行路口或现代新辟交通门当作明代四大正门。城门建筑经拆毁和现代恢复，通道线不等于明代门楼的考古建筑轮廓。
properties.enNote: The original named OSM gate-passage line is retained inside the wall, rather than moving the historic gate to a nearby modern traffic opening. This is a present passage following demolition/restoration, not a surveyed Ming gatehouse footprint.

properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状正门道影像定位参照
properties.enStatus: Present main-gate passage vicinity from imagery
properties.note: 按卫星影像中北门城楼南侧主门道与武定街中轴核对定位，与原始OSM武定门瓮城相邻。点为现状门道地段，不是原门楼测绘中心；不以旁侧现代交通门代替武定正门。
properties.enNote: A present north-gate passage vicinity is checked against satellite imagery, Wuding Street and the mapped barbican. It is not a surveyed historic gatehouse centre or one of the modern flanking traffic openings.

properties.label: 代王府复建区
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状复建区标绘 · 非历史王府实测界
properties.enStatus: Present reconstruction area; not a surveyed historic palace boundary
properties.note: 保留OSM代王府现状复建区范围。历史王府为明代藩王府，现有建筑群主要为2011年以来恢复重建；不能把该狭长复建区等同历史完整王府、北魏宫城或辽金国子监的考古墙界。九龙壁作为历史遗物另列，不随复建区合并成同一几何或打卡。
properties.enNote: The mapped present reconstruction area of Prince Dai Palace is retained. It is a Ming princely residence reconstructed from 2011, not the full historic palace or a surveyed Northern Wei palace/Liao-Jin academy boundary. The surviving Nine-Dragon Wall remains a separate feature and visit identity.

properties.label: 九龙壁
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测
properties.enStatus: Original OSM mapped remains/reconstructed components; not archaeological survey
properties.note: 明代代王府相关琉璃龙壁遗物，保留原始建筑轮廓；与街对面的现代复建王府区分，不作为全部王府范围。
properties.enNote: Original mapped surviving building footprint; historical fabric is distinguished from the modern Prince Dai Palace reconstruction. This is not a city or palace boundary.

properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据

properties.enNote: Original mapped surviving building footprint; historical fabric is distinguished from the modern Prince Dai Palace reconstruction. This is not a city or palace boundary.

properties.label: 关帝庙大殿
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测

properties.enNote: Original mapped surviving building footprint; historical fabric is distinguished from the modern Prince Dai Palace reconstruction. This is not a city or palace boundary.

properties.label: 四牌楼
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现状遗存／复建构件原始OSM标绘 · 非考古实测
properties.enStatus: Original OSM mapped remains/reconstructed components; not archaeological survey
properties.note: 采用原始OSM四牌楼位置，现为恢复重建的城内街巷节点。市古城保护部门说明四牌楼是今古城十字大街中心；其位置用于辽金西京根点在城内的代表性参照，不据此认定辽金原宫殿中心。
properties.enNote: Original mapped location of the reconstructed Four Archways at the city street crossroads. The municipal protection centre describes this as the current city street centre. It serves only as an interior representative for the Liao-Jin capital marker, not an identified original palace centre.

properties.label: 操场城西侧土墙
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现存开放土墙 · 多期遗址位置参照
properties.enStatus: Surviving open earth walls; multiphase site context
properties.note: 保留操场城现存土墙的原始开放OSM墙线，同一方向合并为一项以减少重复标签，不补接缺口。考古与建筑研究记载此区存在战汉、北魏、辽金及明清叠压，现存墙体亦经多期使用；按相应时期查看仅作遗址位置参照，不把整条地表现存土墙断定为某一期原墙，也不据这些线强闭合北魏宫城。 本轮分期复核：整组现存墙线仅列明清现状；北魏及辽金相关地段另以考古定位参照表达，不因同一遗址叠压就把南部后期延伸与横向封墙归入早期。
properties.enNote: Original open mapped earth-wall segments in Caochangcheng are grouped by direction without joining gaps. Studies report superposed Han, Northern Wei, Liao-Jin and later remains here; period reuse is location context, not attribution of the complete visible wall to one dynasty. No closed Northern Wei palace circuit is fabricated. Phase review: the complete surviving mixed group is displayed under Ming/Qing only; separately qualified early-phase references exclude later transverse closures.

properties.note: 保留操场城现存土墙的原始开放OSM墙线，同一方向合并为一项以减少重复标签，不补接缺口。考古与建筑研究记载此区存在战汉、北魏、辽金及明清叠压，现存墙体亦经多期使用；按相应时期查看仅作遗址位置参照，不把整条地表现存土墙断定为某一期原墙，也不据这些线强闭合北魏宫城。 本轮分期复核：整组现存墙线仅列明清现状；北魏及辽金相关地段另以考古定位参照表达，不因同一遗址叠压就把南部后期延伸与横向封墙归入早期。
properties.enNote: Original open mapped earth-wall segments in Caochangcheng are grouped by direction without joining gaps. Studies report superposed Han, Northern Wei, Liao-Jin and later remains here; period reuse is location context, not attribution of the complete visible wall to one dynasty. No closed Northern Wei palace circuit is fabricated. Phase review: the complete surviving mixed group is displayed under Ming/Qing only; separately qualified early-phase references exclude later transverse closures.

properties.label: 明堂复原展示建筑
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 现代复原展示建筑 · 非北魏原建筑轮廓
properties.enStatus: Modern display reconstruction; not an original Northern Wei building
properties.note: 保留明堂公园内中央复原展示建筑的原始OSM轮廓；地上仿古展示建筑不是1995—1996年发掘的明堂原始台基，也不是南门遗址的测绘界。北魏明堂公园原范围继续保留，原址南门保护展示的独立精确轮廓仍待原图定位，不用现代屋顶替代地下遗迹。
properties.enNote: Original mapped footprint of the central modern Mingtang display reconstruction, not the excavated original platform or surveyed south-gate remains. The existing park outline is unchanged. The protected original south-gate footprint awaits independent registration; modern roofs are not substituted for buried remains.

properties.label: 北魏平城外城城墙
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 考古研究定位参照 · 非早期墙基实测线
properties.enStatus: Archaeological-study location reference; not a surveyed early wall footing
properties.note: 张志忠《大同古城的历史变迁》（2008，第31、33页）据夯土叠压调查，将今府城东、南、西墙一带的早期墙体联系到北魏外城；2011年研究对外城尺度另有解释。本线仅以现状城墙内缘核对三面墙垣所在走廊，位置和厚度不等于地下北魏墙基实测值。去除现代门道凹口、马面、瓮城，不复制明代防御形制；转角与北部未连线，不构成完整外城或郭城复原。
properties.enNote: Zhang Zhizhong (2008, pp.31,33) associates early rammed-earth layers along the present east, south and west walls with the Northern Wei outer city; the 2011 study gives another interpretation of its dimensions. Present inner-edge coordinates locate broad wall corridors only, not surveyed ancient footings or wall thickness. Modern gate recesses and defenses are omitted. Corners and the north are left open; this is not a complete outer-city or outermost enclosure reconstruction.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.sourceName: 北魏平城宫城墙遗址地段
properties.label: 北魏平城宫城墙遗址地段
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 考古研究定位参照 · 非早期墙基实测线
properties.enStatus: Archaeological-study location reference; not a surveyed early wall footing
properties.note: 2008年考古调查研究指出，操场城北墙及东、西墙北部存在汉、北魏及晚期墙体叠压，北魏层属于沿旧城加筑的宫城墙。三段定位保留OSM原始开放墙线（868628036、868628038、868628043），只标示相关遗址地段，不把地表现存墙面全部断为北魏原物，也未获得各期内核独立测绘界。南部后期延伸与横向封墙不纳入本项；缺口不补接，宫城不强行闭合。
properties.enNote: The 2008 archaeological study identifies superposed Han, Northern Wei and later wall fabric along the northern and northern-side walls of Caochangcheng. Three original open OSM segments locate the relevant remains areas, rather than surveyed individual ancient cores. Surface fabric is not wholly Northern Wei. Later southern extensions and transverse closures are excluded; gaps remain open.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 辽金西京城墙
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 考古研究定位参照 · 非早期墙基实测线
properties.enStatus: Archaeological-study location reference; not a surveyed early wall footing
properties.note: 张志忠（2008，第33—34页）据墙体调查和《辽史》提出：1044年升西京后，旧外城与北部宫城城垣连为凸字形，金代沿用；操场城东西墙南段内核有辽代遗物，南封墙及今府城北墙中段属明代。本项以现府城东、南、西内缘作旧墙走廊参照，并保留六条操场城原始开放墙线的纵向／北面部分；西南、东南横向明代封墙不纳入。未测得辽金内核独立坐标，北部连接段、缺口和完整城门位置待核，不把凸字形研究解释画成精确闭合城界。
properties.enNote: Zhang Zhizhong (2008, pp.33–34) interprets the capital after 1044 as an integrated northern projection joining the older outer city and palace walls, retained under Jin. Liao material occurs in the southern side-wall cores of Caochangcheng, while transverse southern closures and the main city north-center wall are Ming. Present inner edges locate three broad old-wall corridors, with six original open northern wall segments (transverse southern returns omitted). Early cores have no independent surveyed coordinates here. Connecting stretches, gaps and gate locations remain unresolved; no precise closed circuit is invented.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 北魏平城外城
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 2008年城址研究复原 · 闭合参考面，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 2008 historical-city reconstruction; closed reference area, not a surveyed wall boundary
properties.note: 采用张志忠2008年第31页“外城大致相当于今府城内侧城圈”的研究方案，按现状OSM内缘核对四至后形成低透明度闭合参考面。北边及转角为研究补接，不是北魏墙基测绘；现代瓮城、门道和马面未套入。2011年研究对外城尺度与宫城关系存在不同解释，本面不代表定论，更不等于三十二里郭城。原开放墙线保留。 显示复核：东、西、南三面沿用此前开放参考线的精确线段，转角使用原始OSM内缘连接，撤销新增四边形的直边简化；与原参考线不再并列显示。
properties.enNote: Uses Zhang Zhizhong’s 2008 (p.31) interpretation of the outer city approximately inside the present main-city circuit. Present inner-edge coordinates locate broad limits; the northern closure and corners are interpretive, not surveyed Northern Wei footings. Modern gate defenses are omitted. The 2011 study differs on dimensions and palace relationships. This is one hypothesis, not the outermost enclosure. Original open references remain. Display review: the previous three open side references are retained exactly within the circuit, connected through original OSM inner-edge corners. The simplified quadrilateral sides were replaced; duplicate references are not displayed.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 北魏平城宫城
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 2008年城址研究复原 · 闭合参考面，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 2008 historical-city reconstruction; closed reference area, not a surveyed wall boundary
properties.note: 采用2008年第29—30页“操场城北部、东西街南约50米以北”的宫城研究方案。北、西及东侧已有开放OSM土墙作为地段参照；南界以今操场城街位置南约50米推定，东北缺口与其余连接为研究补线。宫城南界并非明北关城南封墙；本面不把整个北关城当北魏宫城。不是原始考古测量，不细分未定位的东、西宫，不覆盖或修改现存墙线。
properties.enNote: Uses the 2008 (pp.29–30) interpretation of the palace in northern Caochangcheng, north of a line about 50 m south of its east–west street. Open OSM walls locate northern and side remains; the south and northeast gap are interpretive connections. The south does not follow the later Ming southern closure. This is not surveyed archaeology or a map of individually located eastern/western palaces; original walls remain unchanged.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 辽金西京大同城
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 2008年城址研究复原 · 闭合参考面，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 2008 historical-city reconstruction; closed reference area, not a surveyed wall boundary
properties.note: 依据张志忠2008年第33—34页城墙调查及其凸字形方案：1044年升西京后，把旧外城与北部宫城城垣相连，金代沿用。现府城东南西内缘与操场城原始开放土墙提供地段参照，原始墙线与孔洞全部保留；北侧长缺口、东北角、东西连接段及主城转角以研究补线闭合。本面表示该研究方案的城郭范围，不表示各时代内核的实测坐标。未将今府城北墙中段和操场城南封墙画成辽金内部城墙，也不套用明代瓮城、马面。 显示复核：东、西、南三面沿用此前开放参考线的精确线段，转角使用原始OSM内缘连接，撤销新增四边形的直边简化；与原参考线不再并列显示。
properties.enNote: Based on Zhang Zhizhong’s 2008 (pp.33–34) projecting-north interpretation after 1044, retained under Jin. Present main-city inner edges and original open Caochangcheng earth walls locate the broad circuit. The northern gap, northeast corner, joining stretches and main-city corners are interpretive closures. This is a research extent, not a survey of ancient wall cores. The Ming north-center and southern transverse closure are not represented as Liao-Jin internal walls; modern gate defenses are omitted. Display review: the previous three open side references are retained exactly within the circuit, connected through original OSM inner-edge corners. The simplified quadrilateral sides were replaced; duplicate references are not displayed.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.sourceName: 北魏平城郭城墙地望（南、西地段）
properties.label: 北魏郭城墙地望
properties.enName: Northern Wei outermost wall candidate corridors (south/west)
properties.enSourceName: Northern Wei outermost wall candidate corridors (south/west)
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 讲座文献推测地段 · 现代道路仅作定位参照，非墙基遗迹
properties.enStatus: Documentary candidate corridors; modern roads are locators, not ancient wall remains
properties.note: 郭城与北魏宫城、外城不是同一城圈。《魏书》记422年筑郭，周回三十二里；2008年城址研究指出郭城证据薄弱、具体四至有争议。2022年12月6日张志忠在中国人民大学讲座的纪要（谢超楠执笔，中国文物报发布，现可读转载）提出迎宾大道、魏都大道可能对应南、西墙。本项仅保留该假说在当前取数范围内的南、西候选走廊，用原始OSM迎宾街与魏都大道单侧道路几何定位，不表示城墙沿现代道路弯折、宽度或路口施工形状。该纪要未提供可核验的原始墙基坐标；安益街北墙、古城村西东墙及四角均未落线，不能将这些开放走廊补成完整郭城，更不能将四周三十二里直接换算成矩形。
properties.enNote: The outermost enclosure is distinct from the palace and outer city. A 422 construction is documented, but its limits remain disputed. A published account of Zhang Zhizhong’s 6 Dec 2022 Renmin University lecture suggests Yingbin and Weidu avenues as possible southern/western limits. Original OSM road geometries locate only those candidate corridors in the available extract; modern bends, widths and junctions do not represent ancient wall construction. The account supplies no independently verifiable wall-footing coordinates. Northern/eastern walls and corners remain undrawn; no complete circuit is inferred from circumference.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 中华门
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 文献方位示意点 · 非已定位、已发掘城门遗址
properties.enStatus: Documentary orientation marker, not a located/excavated gate site
properties.note: 叶骁军2011年论文第40—41页据文献图说明宫门方位：南中华、东云龙、西神虎、北中阳。它们是宫门，不是郭城十二门；乾元、端门、掖门等另有记载，因内部位置未可靠定位，不全部套到宫墙上。以492年文献布局作阶段参照，不认定为始建年份。 本点仅为了展示史载方位而放在所关联研究城郭的相应边线上；沿墙的具体位置、古门道轴线和门基轮廓均未经考古确认，不能按此导航寻找遗址。没有把明代门址当作同名古门，点位不提供独立遗迹打卡。
properties.enNote: Ye Xiaojun (2011, pp.40–41) describes palace-gate orientations: Zhonghua south, Yunlong east, Shenhu west and Zhongyang north. These are palace gates, not the twelve outermost-city gates. Other internal gate names remain documentary; 492 is a layout-reference phase, not a foundation date. The point is an orientation marker on the corresponding research circuit. Its specific position along that edge, ancient axis and footing have not been archaeologically established. It is not a navigable excavated site and has no independent remains check-in.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

properties.label: 迎春门
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 文献方位示意点 · 非已定位、已发掘城门遗址
properties.enStatus: Documentary orientation marker, not a located/excavated gate site
properties.note: 《辽史·地理志》及张志忠2008年第33页记西京东迎春、南朝阳、西定西、北拱极四门。以1044年升西京为阶段参照，暂只表达辽代名称，不以相同名称断言金代沿用。拱极门按凸字形研究城郭的北侧表达，未直接套在明代武定门上。 本点仅为了展示史载方位而放在所关联研究城郭的相应边线上；沿墙的具体位置、古门道轴线和门基轮廓均未经考古确认，不能按此导航寻找遗址。没有把明代门址当作同名古门，点位不提供独立遗迹打卡。
properties.enNote: The Liao History and Zhang Zhizhong (2008, p.33) name Yingchun east, Chaoyang south, Dingxi west and Gongji north. The 1044 reference expresses Liao names only; Jin name continuity is not assumed. Gongji is placed on the northern projection rather than at Ming Wuding Gate. The point is an orientation marker on the corresponding research circuit. Its specific position along that edge, ancient axis and footing have not been archaeologically established. It is not a navigable excavated site and has no independent remains check-in.

properties.enNote: The Liao History and Zhang Zhizhong (2008, p.33) name Yingchun east, Chaoyang south, Dingxi west and Gongji north. The 1044 reference expresses Liao names only; Jin name continuity is not assumed. Gongji is placed on the northern projection rather than at Ming Wuding Gate. The point is an orientation marker on the corresponding research circuit. Its specific position along that edge, ancient axis and footing have not been archaeologically established. It is not a navigable excavated site and has no independent remains check-in.

properties.sourceName: 北魏平城郭城（研究候选）
properties.label: 北魏平城郭城（待考）
properties.sourceTitle: 大同城垣、宫府、遗址与分期依据
properties.status: 学术示意图候选范围 · 四至待考，非考古实测城墙
properties.enStatus: Candidate circuit from an academic schematic; limits unconfirmed, not surveyed archaeological walls
properties.note: 复核武彤2024年第50页图3：图题为“四郊礼制空间示意图”，黑色虚线圈只能作为研究候选，不能将四郊空间和已确认郭城墙混同。恢复原相似变换转绘的闭合几何，撤销2026-10-23为贴合宫城及现状御河而人工北移约200米、东移约550米的改动；古河与现代河道不能未经证据强制重合。原图内四个府城参照点残差约32米，独立明堂点偏差约694米，说明示意图不能提供精确绝对范围。平城区政府2026年3月资料仍说明四至尚未确定，后续须取得分期考古总图与控制点。现存OSM墙体、宫城、外城及明堂点均不移动。
properties.enNote: Figure 3 on p.50 of Wu Tong (2024) is explicitly a schematic of suburban ritual space; its dashed enclosure is only a research hypothesis, not a confirmed archaeological circuit. Restore the original similarity-transformed outline and reject the unsupported north/east shifts made on 2026-10-23 to match the palace and present river. Modern and ancient river courses cannot be forced to coincide. About 32 m contextual residuals coexist with a 694 m independent Mingtang discrepancy, demonstrating major schematic distortion. The Pingcheng government stated in March 2026 that the city limits remain undetermined. Original OSM walls, palace/city references and the Mingtang point remain unchanged.
properties.geometryBasis: Early-phase attribution: Zhang Zhizhong 2008, pp.30–34; present locator geometry: original OSM. These are distinct evidence levels.

ancient-site:平城遗址:40.09000,113.30000.name: 北魏 · 平城宫城及周边遗址
ancient-site:平城遗址:40.09000,113.30000.boundaryStatus: 郭城闭合研究候选，四至待考；本轮撤销无控制点的人工平移
ancient-site:平城遗址:40.09000,113.30000.summary: 依据2008年考古调查研究区分北魏墙体层位与明清现状土墙；外城三面走廊及宫城北部墙段以虚线定位参照表达，不宣称地下墙基实测，不闭合缺口。2011年研究对外城尺度有不同解释；一、二、三号基址与铁牛里独立测绘仍待核，明堂展示建筑不代替原台基。 新增两个淡填充闭合研究面；南界、缺口与转角补接逐项说明。该方案与2011年外城尺度解释有差异，不作为定论。 郭城明确独立列项：422年筑郭见文献，南、西候选地望不是实测墙基。中华、云龙、神虎、中阳按文献方位表达，未将十二京城门任意落点。 郭城新增2024年学术示意图黑色虚线城圈的闭合候选范围；不用外围四郊红框，未将图件配准误差当作墙界精度。 2026-10-28复核仅恢复源图可复算转绘，保留694米独立检验偏差，不称为精确考古城界。

sources.title: 大同分期与原始几何说明
北魏平城宫城及其主要建筑遗迹考证（2011）
张志忠：大同古城的历史变迁（2008）
武彤：试论北魏平城的礼制空间（2024），图3

ancient-site:西京大同:40.07680,113.30010.name: 辽金 · 西京大同府
ancient-site:西京大同:40.07680,113.30010.boundaryStatus: 凸字形闭合研究参考面；原始开放墙段与推定连接区分
ancient-site:西京大同:40.07680,113.30010.summary: 依据2008年考古调查研究补入辽金墙垣相关地段：三面旧墙走廊与操场城纵向／北面墙段，剔除明代横向封墙。凸字形为研究解释，未用随意线补闭合；华严寺、善化寺等原始几何保留。 新增2008年凸字形西京闭合参考面，缺口及连接段是研究补线，非墙基实测。 新增辽代迎春、朝阳、定西、拱极四门的方位示意；拱极在北凸部分，均非已发掘门基定位，金代名称不据此套用。

ancient-site:西京大同:40.07680,113.30010.boundaryStatus: 现状城墙完整外环、十二孔洞，四正门及十一处防御庭院
ancient-site:西京大同:40.07680,113.30010.summary: 城墙按原始OSM多边形接入，现存夯土与现代包砖、复建构件有别。BIAM主城212粗轮廓撤出显示，由贴合现状墙形的城内参考面替代；其余三个关城历史参照保留。此为边镇府城分期，不新增明清国家首都记录。
